title: Luxurious East Nashville Room | Private Entrance
description:
This adorable, modern, private room has all the comforts of home, and the convenient location of your Downtown Nashville Dreams! Only 4 mins East of the City, 12 mins from BNA airport, and a short walk to countless bars + restaurants w/ that unique East Nash spirit. Your room has a completely separate private entrance (no shared space), a private bathroom, closet,  WiFi, & smart TV. Cozy up inside, or take a short walk or even shorter Uber to breweries, bars, restaurants, music venues, etc.

The space
This is a private bedroom & bathroom in the bottom of a townhome. There are NO shared spaces so you will have the room all to yourself!

There is a pin-pad code for easy, secure entry.

Guest access
You have full access to the bedroom & bathroom! They’re all yours and you will not need to share space with anyone else.

During your stay
We probably won't see each other, but I'm always on the other end of the phone if you need anything! I'm happy to help with recommendations, or making you more comfortable in any way I can.
